body:
### Focused CI/consumer progress — 2026-10-28

BUILD-001 / #1 is now closed after its **three original criteria** passed: actual independent WebView Maven consumers on Linux x64, macOS arm64/x64 and Windows x64, both module-metadata and POM-only resolution, **16/16 executions**, eight fresh XML, and identical generated dependency selectors. Successful same-input hosts were not replayed. The original issue and acceptance scope are preserved.

The additional **Linux ARM64** host still fails before consumer tests. Failure-only run [40772821771](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40772821771), immutable `8a2a46e6`, has all **839 Git input hashes held**, producer exit **1 / 161.04 s**, and exactly `selected=[]` for the two expected Maven publications. **Zero consumer methods/XML**; the whole workflow remains failed.

Inspection of the exact Kotlin Gradle plugin **2.4.20** dependency explains this: `PublishingKt.shouldDisablePublishingDueToIncompatibleHost` disables **all** default KMP publications when the Kotlin/Native producer host is unsupported and any native target is declared. Kotlin/Native does not support a Linux ARM64 producer; the project retains its iOS targets even in desktop-only staging. This is publication-task availability, **not a demonstrated JavaFX native failure**. The actual internal branch text was not captured directly on the runner; bounded receipts plus inspected dependency bytecode are the evidence.

I have not enabled the explicitly **internal** KGP override, faked publications, removed targets to alter root metadata, or uploaded candidate JARs outside the reports-only containment policy. A supported producer execution retaining the same metadata is still needed for this extra consumer host. Minimum-platform consumers, full API/JNI/Swift compatibility, remaining native/device regressions and security/readiness gates also keep **#3 open**. No package/release/deployment has been published.

Evidence: `docs/development/evidence/webview-consumer-important-20261028/arm64-diagnostics-native001/{failed-review.json,dependency-host-publication-explanation.json}`. Original failures and four accepted host results remain preserved.
